description: Cross-sheet references in the governed workbook and how each unresolved value is classified. crosswalk and null-token rules are mechanical and must resolve every value they match; merge rules resolve when phase 2 consolidates the named entities; owner rules wait on a data-owner decision.

rules.note: Forecast runs are keyed per run and horizon; validations carry the horizon in horizon_bucket_hours.
Module-level life history cites serialised PV modules, which become PV module records, not assets.
Resources that are not crews (vehicles, equipment) carry N/A; stored as null.
Portfolio-level rows become projections in phase 3, not site rows.
PV module interventions exist only in the plan register; resolved by the phase 2 intervention merge.
Requirements of the PV module interventions; resolved by the phase 2 intervention merge.
Spares for the PV module interventions; resolved by the phase 2 intervention merge.
Plan scenarios are a second scenario register; resolved by the phase 2 scenario merge.
Second part master; resolved by the phase 2 part merge.
HSE incidents have their own ID space; phase 2 moves them to hse_incident.

rules.question: HSE incidents cite work orders WO-7001…WO-7024 that are not in the work-order register. Add them, or drop the link?
220 work orders cite an AST-H asset series (tags such as SP-01-INV-H01) that the asset master lacks. Add these assets, or remap the work orders to existing assets?
Interventions cite the same AST-H asset series as the work orders. Same decision applies.
Planned work orders WO-20xxx and WO-40xxx are referenced by planning sheets but absent from the work-order register. Create them as planned work orders, or treat them as not yet released?
CBM and RCA cases use an alternate asset naming per plant (SP01-INV-A01, ARV-INV-204, DEC-INV-411, VIN-TRF-709). Provide the mapping to asset-master IDs, or add these as assets?
The event log uses plant codes SOL-01… that do not exist in Sites. Map them to SP-xx plants?
The event log uses short asset codes (INV-001, TRF-004). Map them to asset-master IDs?
RCA cases cite events ERC-001… that are not in the event log. Add the originating events, or treat ERC IDs as the case's own event reference?
Spares requirements cite a forecast asset series AST-F… with no asset records. Are these planned assets?
Spares requirements cite forecast work orders WO-F… Are they planned work orders to create?
Spares requirements cite forecast interventions INT-F… Are they planned interventions to create?

Optimization rows cite INT-00001… Stripping the padding finds INT-001…, but 148 of 160 rows then point to a different asset, so they are not the same interventions. Which register do these IDs belong to?
Governance rows cite the same INT-00001 series as optimization. Same decision applies.
